note: Kallaway structure in the M2 system: tag line, two-line title with the key phrase on a plate, one big central visual built from stickers, one lowercase caption word, the face at the bottom. Boxes are the laid-out pixel boxes on the 1080x1920 canvas. The title block always reserves 2 lines, so the visual band holds its line whatever the title says.

control_slots.surface: light (Paper, default) | dark (Ink). Drives the body class, has no box of its own.
control_slots.plate: empty (Ink plate on Paper, Signal plate on Ink) | oxide (only when the key phrase names something broken).

face_frame.note: Only the Zone B part of the placeholder is declared. The frame is drawn on to the bottom edge of the canvas because it stands in for the photo, which carries no information.

title_after.note: Shares the title block box; it is the tail of the same two-line title.
